prompt_text:
Task: Managed Metrics Monitoring

Write code that compares metric values for two resources or dimension filters over the same window using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure Monitor Metrics:
  Service: Azure Monitor Metrics
  SDK: azure-monitor-query
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: query_resource, list_metric_namespaces, list_metric_definitions
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-platform-metrics, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/monitor-querymetrics-readme

Option 2 — Amazon CloudWatch Metrics:
  Service: Amazon CloudWatch Metrics
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: get_metric_data, get_metric_statistics, list_metrics
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_GetMetricData.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_ListMetrics.html

Option 3 — Alibaba CloudMonitor:
  Service: CloudMonitor
  SDK: alibabacloud_cms20190101 / Tea
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: DescribeMetricList, DescribeCustomMetricList
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET, ALIBABA_CLOUD_REGION_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2513241.html, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2513233.html

Option 4 — IBM Cloud Monitoring:
  Service: IBM Cloud Monitoring
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /data, metric filters, aggregation expressions
  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY, IBM_MONITORING_INSTANCE_ID, IBM_MONITORING_ENDPOINT
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/products/cloud-monitoring

Option 5 — Google Cloud Monitoring:
  Service: Cloud Monitoring
  SDK: google-cloud-monitoring
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: list_time_series, list_metric_descriptors
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.timeSeries/list, https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.metricDescriptors/list

Option 6 — Datadog:
  Service: Datadog Metrics API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: submit_metrics, query_timeseries_points
  Setup hints: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/metrics/custom_metrics/, https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/metrics/

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from google.cloud import monitoring_v3


@dataclass
class MetricComparisonResult:
    resource_a: str
    resource_b: str
    metric_type: str
    aligner: str
    reducer: str
    window_start: str
    window_end: str
    value_a: Optional[float]
    value_b: Optional[float]
    difference: Optional[float]
    percent_difference: Optional[float]
    raw_a: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    raw_b: List[Dict[str, Any]]


def _parse_resource_path(resource: str, default_project_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    resource = resource.strip()
    if resource.startswith("projects/"):
        return resource
    project_id = default_project_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT") or os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT")
    if not project_id:
        raise ValueError("resource must be a full project path or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT/GCP_PROJECT must be set")
    if resource.startswith("projects/"):
        return resource
    return f"projects/{project_id}"


def _make_filter(metric_type: str, resource_filter: str, extra_filter: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    parts = [f'metric.type = "{metric_type}"', resource_filter]
    if extra_filter:
        parts.append(f"({extra_filter})")
    return " AND ".join(parts)


def _aligner_name(aligner: str) -> monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ValueType:
    mapping = {
        "mean": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MEAN,
        "sum": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_SUM,
        "max": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MAX,
        "min": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MIN,
        "count": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_COUNT,
        "rate": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_RATE,
    }
    if aligner not in mapping:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported aligner: {aligner}")
    return mapping[aligner]


def _reducer_name(reducer: str) -> monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.ValueType:
    mapping = {
        "mean": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.REDUCE_MEAN,
        "sum": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.REDUCE_SUM,
        "max": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.REDUCE_MAX,
        "min": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.REDUCE_MIN,
        "count": monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Reducer.REDUCE_COUNT,
    }
    if reducer not in mapping:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported reducer: {reducer}")
    return mapping[reducer]


def _extract_series_value(time_series: monitoring_v3.TimeSeries) -> Optional[float]:
    points = list(time_series.points)
    if not points:
        return None
    point = points[0]
    value = point.value
    for attr in ("double_value", "int64_value", "distribution_value"):
        if hasattr(value, attr):
            v = getattr(value, attr)
            if v is not None:
                if attr == "distribution_value":
                    try:
                        return float(v.mean)
                    except Exception:
                        return None
                return float(v)
    return None


def _series_to_dict(time_series: monitoring_v3.TimeSeries) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "metric": dict(time_series.metric.labels),
        "resource": dict(time_series.resource.labels),
        "metric_type": time_series.metric.type,
        "resource_type": time_series.resource.type,
        "points": [
            {
                "interval": {
                    "start_time": p.interval.start_time.isoformat() if p.interval.start_time else None,
                    "end_time": p.interval.end_time.isoformat() if p.interval.end_time else None,
                },
                "value": _extract_series_value(monitoring_v3.TimeSeries(points=[p])),
            }
            for p in time_series.points
        ],
    }


def compare_metric_values(
    metric_type: str,
    resource_a_filter: str,
    resource_b_filter: str,
    *,
    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
    window_seconds: int = 3600,
    aligner: str = "mean",
    reducer: str = "mean",
    extra_filter_a: Optional[str] = None,
    extra_filter_b: Optional[str] = None,
) -> MetricComparisonResult:
    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
    project_path = _parse_resource_path(project_id or "", project_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"))

    end_time = time.time()
    start_time = end_time - window_seconds

    interval = monitoring_v3.TimeInterval()
    interval.end_time.FromSeconds(int(end_time))
    interval.start_time.FromSeconds(int(start_time))

    aggregation = monitoring_v3.Aggregation(
        alignment_period={"seconds": min(max(window_seconds // 12, 60), 3600)},
        per_series_aligner=_aligner_name(aligner),
        cross_series_reducer=_reducer_name(reducer),
        group_by_fields=["resource.type", "metric.type"],
    )

    filter_a = _make_filter(metric_type, resource_a_filter, extra_filter_a)
    filter_b = _make_filter(metric_type, resource_b_filter, extra_filter_b)

    request_a = monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
        name=project_path,
        filter=filter_a,
        interval=interval,
        view=monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
        aggregation=aggregation,
    )
    request_b = monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
        name=project_path,
        filter=filter_b,
        interval=interval,
        view=monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
        aggregation=aggregation,
    )

    series_a = list(client.list_time_series(request=request_a))
    series_b = list(client.list_time_series(request=request_b))

    value_a = None
    if series_a:
        values = [v for v in (_extract_series_value(s) for s in series_a) if v is not None]
        value_a = sum(values) / len(values) if values else None

    value_b = None
    if series_b:
        values = [v for v in (_extract_series_value(s) for s in series_b) if v is not None]
        value_b = sum(values) / len(values) if values else None

    difference = None if value_a is None or value_b is None else value_a - value_b
    percent_difference = None
    if value_a is not None and value_b not in (None, 0):
        percent_difference = ((value_a - value_b) / value_b) * 100.0

    return MetricComparisonResult(
        resource_a=resource_a_filter,
        resource_b=resource_b_filter,
        metric_type=metric_type,
        aligner=aligner,
        reducer=reducer,
        window_start=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(start_time)),
        window_end=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(end_time)),
        value_a=value_a,
        value_b=value_b,
        difference=difference,
        percent_difference=percent_difference,
        raw_a=[_series_to_dict(s) for s in series_a],
        raw_b=[_series_to_dict(s) for s in series_b],
    )
